messages:
Maya: Heads up — saw 3 incoming marketplace leads that matched SI territories but were auto-assigned to Sales. Is the claim window for SI set to 48h still?
Sanjay: we set it to 24h last month for the pilot. maybe that didn't propagate to new intake queue. pinging ops-bot
ops-bot: Routing rule update deployed: marketplace-intake v2 -> default 24h SI claim window :white_check_mark:
Elena: That's likely it. But two of the leads were MQLs from our HW partner co-sell (NimbleHW) and per the partnership agreement those should be SI-owned. We need an override path.
Maya: Can we add a metadata check: partner == 'NimbleHW' => immediate SI hold (no auto-assign)?
Sanjay: agree. quick fix: add partner hold in intake lambda. snippet:
```
if lead.partner == 'nimblehw':
    lead.hold_for_si = True
```
Chris: Risk: that will create backlog on SI side for low-fit leads. Propose add threshold: ARR >= 250k or product-fit tag present.
Elena: Yes — use arr_estimate >= 250000 or tags contains 'hw-qualified'. That keeps low-fit leads flowing to sales.
Maya: Who owns rollout? Ops?
Sanjay: Ops to patch today, we'll monitor next 48h. ops-bot, can you schedule a canary and alert channel #partnerships if backlog > 10?
ops-bot: Canary scheduled. Alert rule created: if si_hold_queue_size > 10 -> notify #partnerships #eng-sales and run auto-unhold after 72h.
Maya: :thumbsup: Also request a manual override button in the intake UI (fast handoff) — I'll request Sarah in Product.
Chris: Opened ticket PROD-8423, assigned to Sarah. ETA 1 week.
Elena: Also need account mapping doc updated (territory carve for NimbleHW). I'll push a small change to Confluence and ping the SI leads.
Maya: Thanks. Follow-up: after patch, let's run a sweep of leads from timestamps 1744050000-1744129875 to capture any misrouted ones.
Sanjay: I'll run the sweep script and post results here once done.
Maya: If we find >5 misroutes, we'll do a retro with SI ops and adjust the marketplace intake pipeline.
Chris: noted. tagging @Elena for mapping changes and @Sanjay for sweep when ready.
